text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: For so long I've yearned…

text_block_list.name: Young Zephyr
text_block_list.text: …Mother, am I to stay out of the forest today as well?

text_block_list.name: Zephyr's Mom
text_block_list.text: Yes, I think you'd better. You're still feeling sore, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Zephyr's Mom
text_block_list.text: You can go and play once the injury stops hurting. I'm sure the clean air will do you good.

text_block_list.name: Zephyr's Mom
text_block_list.text: Just don't get too excited, okay? You'll end up injuring yourself again.

text_block_list.name: Young Zephyr
text_block_list.text: …Okay, I won't.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fwoooshhh…

text_block_list.name: Young Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Ah…

text_block_list.name: Young Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (Those leaves… The wind has swept them up so high.)

text_block_list.name: Young Zephyr
text_block_list.text: …It must be nice.

text_block_list.name: Young Zephyr
text_block_list.text: How does it feel to be the wind?

text_block_list.name: Young Zephyr
text_block_list.text: You can just whooshhh wherever you like… How does that—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Wind-Like Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (I wonder… how does it feel? To be so strong, so sharp, and so, so fast—faster than anyone!)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (If only I could run like that!)

text_block_list.name: Wind-Like Umamusume
text_block_list.text: If you want to make something of yourself, then come.

text_block_list.name: Wind-Like Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Come to Tracen Academy, and join the Twinkle Series!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I yearned and yearned… And now, I…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We're in the waiting room, moments away from the autumn Tenno Sho. After sitting in silent contemplation for a while, Yamanin Zephyr opens her eyes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Then, she looks straight at me and speaks.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Trainer. Do you remember?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: When you told me that the wind is free…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I remember, of course. This was before tryouts…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It was something I said to motivate her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: "The wind runs however it wants, right?"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: "The wind runs however it wants, right?"

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: For whatever reason, those words came to mind just now.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: And they helped me decide that today, I am going to become free—freer than anything or anyone.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Freely, unswayed, I'm going to take all that blows about me and draw strength from it.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: The rushing winds of the sprints, the fierce gales of the miles…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: And the hurricanes that howl through the medium races… I'll breathe every last one of them in.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I—and no one else—will rise as the one and only true tempest.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Yes?
choice_data_list: I'll be at the finish line, waiting for the wind.
I'll be at the finish line, waiting for the wind.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Hehe…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Yes. Let the wind wash over you to your heart's content.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With the curtain about to rise on the autumn Tenno Sho, the final stage of our unprecedented triple-distance campaign is finally here.

text_block_list.name: Zephyr Fans
text_block_list.text: Ah… It's happening! The Tenno Sho paddock is about to open!

text_block_list.name: Zephyr Fans
text_block_list.text: All right, raise the banner! Do your best, Yamanin Zephyr!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: …Hm? But you're—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Wait, no. I see.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Let's find out together… just how far the wind will blow.
